description: Two signal processors on one panel: an amplifier with gain and offset, and an inverter with an offset of its own

params.text: Sets the gain of the first section, marked -200 to +200 per cent through zero at the centre
Adds a fixed voltage to the first section's output, marked -5 to +5
Picks whether the second section passes its input as it stands or flips its sign
Adds a fixed voltage to the second section's output, marked -5 to +5

inputs.text: The signal into the first section
The signal into the second section

outputs.text: The first section's input times its gain, plus its offset
The second section's input, flipped or not, plus its offset
